newsitem.title: UK: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases behind last year.
newsitem.headline: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases behind last year.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the 18th week of the 1996/97 season ending February 13 were 5,158 tonnes compared with 5,934 tonnes in the week ending February 15 of the last season.
The Ghana Cocoa Board said cumulative purchases to the end of the 18th week had totalled 286,716 tonnes. This compares with 324,305 tonnes in the corresponding year-ago period.
In the 18th week of the 1995/96 season ending on February 8 the Board had purchased 6,229 tonnes of cocoa with the cumulative reaching 318,371 tonnes.
